etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Unadapted borrowing from French penchant, present participle of pencher (“to tilt, to lean”), from Middle French, from Old French pengier (“to tilt, be out of line”), from Vulgar Latin *pendicāre, a derivative of Latin pendere (“to hang”).
senses: A taste, liking, or inclination for (something).
(card games, uncountable) A card game resembling bezique.
